_comment: The arduino-cli cores CircuitDesk's compiler service is built and validated against.
One source of truth, read by three things that must never disagree: the Docker
image bootstrap (server/compiler/installCores.mjs), the capability endpoint that
tells the app which targets exist, and the deployment smoke test.
Versions are PINNED. An unpinned 'latest' means the compiler service silently
moves under the emulator: the ESP32 runtime here is validated against the ROM
entry tables and startup sequence of one core release, and a core upgrade that
nobody chose would change the firmware the emulator is asked to execute.
Changing a version here is a deliberate act that needs the runtime tests re-run.

arduinoCli.note: Pinned for the same reason the cores are. The image used to install whatever install.sh from master offered, which is how the deployed service ended up on 1.5.1 while a development container ran a 1.5.2 release candidate.

cores.note: AVR boards. Also reachable through the avr-g++ fallback, so a failed install degrades rather than breaks.
Arduino-Pico. Emits .uf2 without a .hex, so an RP2040 build can never be delivered as Intel HEX.

Arduino-ESP32. CircuitDesk compiles only the two RISC-V parts it can execute, so the Xtensa toolchain and the per-chip libraries for parts it does not support are pruned after install — see installCores.mjs.
The Arduino SAM core, for the Due. Built for the programming port, so Serial is the UART on D0/D1; emits a raw binary linked at 0x80000.

STM32duino, for the Nucleo-64 F401RE. Serial is USART2, the ST-LINK's virtual COM port; emits a raw binary linked at 0x08000000. Pruned after install to the F4 series and the compiler's Cortex-M4F libraries — see installCores.mjs.
Adafruit's SAMD core, for the SAMD21 boards CircuitDesk executes (Feather M0, QT Py M0). Emits Intel HEX linked above the boards' 8 KB bootloader.

Seeed's SAMD core, for the XIAO SAMD21. Emits Intel HEX linked above its 8 KB bootloader. Optional because Seeed's board index is not reliably reachable: an image built while it was down ships without it, and XIAO SAMD21 compiles report the missing core rather than the whole build failing.
